observed_comparison.verdict: MATH 2n^2 cumulative closure matches observed noble-gas Z for 2/6 shells (He, Ne only). It DIVERGES from Z=18 onward (28 vs 18, 60 vs 36, ...). The categorical 2n^2 closure does NOT reproduce the observed noble-gas series; the observed pattern follows the Madelung/aufbau period doubling (2,8,8,18,18,32), not pure 2n^2. This is the C1 'magic numbers observed, not derived' gap (shell-construction-rules.md), made precise for electron shells. The math is NOT adjusted to fit.

findings.summary: σ_F(k) is monotone DECREASING along the dressing chain (after k=3), not increasing — claim 1's 'σ_F peaks at closed shells' is NOT supported by the categorical compute. μ≥2 degeneracy is GENERIC (conjugate-pair Wedderburn maximisers at many k), not a noble-gas-specific signature — claim 2's mechanism does not single out closed shells. Reported as computed.
